note: Machine-readable type catalog. Normative for discovery: every production run grounds its type decision here and in references/TYPES.md (the per-type composition contracts). Types are COMPOSED, not instanced — there are no template files. Regenerate on extension; never hand-edit entries.

types.description: Decision brief: one sheet on ivory — options with kill rules, weighted matrix, risk pairs, verdict; the founding brief layout
Evidence dossier: TOC pills, TL;DR pillars, findings with fold-out receipts, citation map, ink verdict; the founding dossier layout
Presentation deck: cover hero, numbered cards, journey SVG, timeline, rec figure; arrow-key navigation (the one sanctioned script)
Introduction of concepts: concept panels with definitions, why-it-matters, fold-out worked examples, cross-link chips, relationship figure; for orienting a reader in a new concept set
Concept breakdown: the anatomy of ONE concept — subject double ring, 4-6 part panels with definition/behavior/boundary, composition figure
Top-down explainer: the whole in one breath, then drill-down levels — statement band, pillar grid, per-pillar detail
I-am-12 explainer: real facts in 12-year-old words — short sentences, everyday metaphors, story-step panels, big-picture close
Feature breakdown: capability cards, pipeline figure, a real source-to-plate proof pair, options table, honest limits
Five-lens explainer: one subject through WHAT/HOW/WHY/WHO/WHEN — giant interrogative stamps, perfectly equal lenses
Decisions log: a ruled, append-ordered ledger of decisions — ID/date/status rail, always-visible one-liner, reversible/irreversible marking
Research report: question, method band, numbered findings with root-cause/fix/status, conclusion contract, recommendations
Directional report: current position, chosen direction with BECAUSE rows, cluster markers timeline, explicit anti-goals
Management report: BLUF verdict, KPI tiles, cluster progress bars, highlights/lowlights, decisions needed — scannable in sixty seconds
Data report: dataset + method, pele pie and xychart charts in clay series colors, metrics table with real byte counts
Annual report: publication-grade yearly summary — cover numeral, year-at-a-glance tiles, signed lead's letter, cluster sections, asks
Project plan: objective band, scope in/out, five phase panels with deliverables/exit-criteria/status, milestone tracks, risk register
High-level timelines and steps: the suite's four core processes as step tracks — numbered circles on hairlines, per-step owners
Workflow template: roles strip, do/verify step rows with role chips, decision-point callouts, per-phase checklists
Meeting notes: attendees, agenda, per-topic discussion, decisions made as chip-led rows, action table with owners and due dates
Interview transcript: turn-taking Q&A in four themes — speaker chips, clay-ruled answers, ink pull quotes; trust notes preserved
Standard operating procedure: doc-control table, numbered clauses with MUST/SHALL, verification, records, revision history
API documentation: precision reference for the build-time CLI — signatures, parameter tables, real captured examples
Request for proposal: outbound solicitation — background, objectives, scope in/out, mandatory/desirable requirements, process
Request for information: the light inquiry — control table, not-a-solicitation strip, four numbered question groups
Business case: retrospective validation of the founding investment — three options with cost models, cost-benefit verdict
Rolling forecast: window band with the re-roll rule, forecast-vs-actuals ledger with variance chips, cumulative chart, assumptions band
Cashflow statement: the build economy in effort hours — inflows/outflows by activity, per-period columns, double-ruled net
2D quadrant overview: items plotted by two axes across four quadrants — native pele quadrantChart, corner-meaning sections
